caption:
The foundation of a man’s desire for you is to access your portal of creation in order to realize his own dreams.

He cannot create without you.

He needs you. 

But because he does not have to earn access to you, he does not value you.

The woman is the most abundant resource on the planet and control of the woman’s generative power and capacity is the sole purpose of patriarchy.

Women don’t just birth life, we birth consciousness and consciousness is what constructs reality.

We have a Divine responsibility to wield this power with deep awareness and ferocity.

Women get played, abused, abandoned and even k*lled because we don’t understand the magnitude of this power and move accordingly.

You must be ruthless with your time, energy, and love, conserving it only for those who have earned the right to access your magic.

Your life literally depends on it.

For the people pleasers, over givers, anxiously attached, and self proclaimed empaths who constantly attract users, manipulators and narcs, it’s time for you to become ruthlessly selfish with your precious life force.

In SELFISH BITCH, my transformative masterclass, and SELFISH BITCH INITIATION, my 3 week transformational program, I teach you not only who you are as a woman, why selfishness makes you magnetic to your desires, and life changing embodiment practices to connect you to the sacred wisdom of your body.

This is valuable for women and teen girls regardless of relationship status.

If you’re ready to see just how good life can get when you say NO to anything that is not congruent with your desires and soul mission, comment SELFISH for the link and receive immediate access to the masterclass and initiation.
author: Andrea Bordeaux
transcript: A man who wants your time and energy but doesn't do anything to make your life easier so that you have more time and energy is a waste of your time and energy. A lot of women fail themselves because they don't recognize the inherent value and power that they possess simply by virtue of their own existence. You as a woman represent the divine feminine. You represent the creative principle. You are creation. You are magnetism, expansion, multiplication, and men know this which is why they spend their entire lives and every single goal that they have is so that they can gain more access to as many women as possible. And the reason why they want to have access to as many women as possible is because they are disconnected from that feminine energy, that feminine essence within themselves, and the only way that they can experience reconciliation is through another woman. This is how men manifest their dreams. This is how men manifest their goals and manifest their desires. It's by extracting your energy and your life force. And so if a man is coming into your world, if he is approaching you, if he's courting you, if he's telling you that he wants to be with you, if he's telling you, oh my God, I love your energy. Oh, I feel so good every time I talk to you. Oh, you just make me feel so amazing. I just love being around you. He is extracting and pulling from your life force, whether it's unconscious or subconscious. That is what they are doing. And so for you as a woman, if you are going to be engaging with men in any form or fashion, he needs to be showing up to your temple with offerings in hand. And I'm not just talking about money. I'm talking about whatever that would mean for you that will make your life easier so that you can continue to be replenished as he is extracting from you because there is no way for you to engage in a relationship with a man without you being extracted from. And I don't care how great this man is, how involved he is as a husband, as a father, as a boyfriend, whatever. He is never going to be giving the same amount of life force expenditure that you are as a woman. There's a reason why married men live longer than single men and married women die sooner than single women. It is because simply by virtue of our existence, our biology, our divine feminine nature, we have a much more powerful life force than men do. So if you're going to engage in any type of a relationship with a man, you need to make sure that he is pouring into you in ways that far, far, far surpass what it is that you were giving to him because what you were giving to him is literally costing you years off of your life. Follow me if you'd like to hear more ferocious and unapologetic wisdom.
title: 'Selfish Bitch' Masterclass Sales Pitch
one_liner: A coach uses feminine-power framing to sell women a selfishness masterclass and 3-week program.
key_points: Women unknowingly give away their 'life force' to men who haven't earned access — framed as a health and power issue
Men are portrayed as energy extractors, so women must demand 'offerings' (effort, resources) before engaging
People-pleasers and over-givers are the target audience, urged to become 'ruthlessly selfish'
Comment 'SELFISH' to get a link to the paid masterclass and 3-week initiation program
